name: Semico Capital Berhad
overview: Semico Capital Berhad 于2026年1月9日完成首次公开募股（IPO）并在马来西亚交易所上市。年内，公司通过合资方式在 Pavilion Bukit Jalil 开设家庭娱乐中心，扩大其家庭娱乐中心运营业务。此外，公司宣派了三次中期单层股息。
overview_en: Semico Capital Berhad completed its initial public offering (IPO) and listed on Bursa Malaysia on 9 January 2026. During the year, the company expanded its family entertainment centre operations by entering into a joint venture to operate a family entertainment outlet at Pavilion Bukit Jalil. In addition, the company declared three interim single-tier dividends.

segments.name: 家庭娱乐中心运营
segments.note: 通过合资在 Pavilion Bukit Jalil 开设家庭娱乐中心，扩大运营规模。
segments.note_en: Expanded operations by entering into a joint venture to operate a family entertainment outlet at Pavilion Bukit Jalil.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Chan Kean Seng 及 Kosmare Sdn. Bhd. 签订合资协议，在 Pavilion Bukit Jalil 购物中心经营家庭娱乐中心，包括街机、卡牌和奖品机、商品零售及相关活动，品牌将从品牌所有者处获得许可。
actions.text_en: Entered into a joint venture and shareholders' agreement with Chan Kean Seng and Kosmare Sdn. Bhd.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司于2026年1月9日完成首次公开募股并在马来西亚交易所上市。
segments.note_en: The company completed its initial public offering and listed on Bursa Malaysia on 9 January 2026.

actions.title: Initial Public Offering
actions.text: 完成首次公开募股（IPO）并在马来西亚交易所上市。
actions.text_en: Completed initial public offering (IPO) and listed on Bursa Malaysia.
